uncited: **Identify Boundary Sides:** For each block, determine which of its 6 faces (left, right, front, back, top, bottom) coincide with the global data boundaries.
- **Time Complexity:** Rendering time is proportional to the number of voxels plus the cost of sharing and compositing.
- **Memory Complexity:** Increased memory usage due to storing shared slices.
This method was developed in the context of parallel volume visualization of time-varying and adaptive-resolution data.
